Lemma
[neck geometry lemma] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Lemma 4\group Kleiner–Lott Surgery Foundations

If $U$ is an $\epsilon $-neck in an $\epsilon $-tube or horn and $S$ is a cross-sectional sphere in $U$, then $S$ separates the two ends.
Proof

\sketch The lowest Ricci eigenspaces define a smooth line field transverse to $S$. If $S$ did not separate the ends, it would bound an embedded $3$-ball, contradicting extension of this line field over the ball.

□
